standard-dialogue-pre-quest.npc: Can you please help me? I'm in a terrible spot of trouble.

options.text: Aha, sounds like a quest. I'll help.

steps.player: Aha, sounds like a quest. I'll help.

steps.npc: Yes yes, I suppose it is a quest. My fiance Ernest and I came upon this house.
Seeing as we were a little lost Ernest decided to go in and ask for directions.
That was an hour ago. That house looks spooky, can you go and see if you can find him for me?

steps.player: Ok, I'll see what I can do.

steps.npc: Thank you, thank you. I'm very grateful.

options.text: No, I'm looking for something to kill.

steps.player: No, I'm looking for something to kill.

standard-dialogue-post-quest.npc: Oh he went off to talk to some green warty guy. I'm sure he'll be back soon.
